entries.reason: AiConnectionSelect compares c.status against the technical connection-status enum connected. The label output is a translated reconnectName message or the saved user-provided c.name; the enum literal itself is never rendered.

AiProviderSetup displayLabel compares the provider ID against gateway. This technical provider discriminator selects the translated providerSetup.setup.gateway message; gateway is not rendered by this conditional.

AiProviderSetup displayLabel compares the provider ID against local. This technical provider discriminator selects the translated providerSetup.setup.local message; local is not rendered by this conditional.

useLocalAiLogin errorMessage uses the message property name in a TypeScript union guard ("message" in error). The property name is never rendered; output preserves the provider diagnostic or selects an already translated localErrors entry.

AgentProviderConnection errorMessage uses the message property name in a TypeScript union guard ("message" in error). The property name is never rendered; output preserves the provider diagnostic or selects an already translated localErrors entry.
